voice-branch-jargon.notes: Worst case in this chapter: the whole table is a git history of the branch. Columns are "| Round | Commit | Key contribution |" with rows such as "| 1 | `12202fb0` | B1 keystone defined; depth-2 fig-8 50-dps witness |" and, for the last row, "| 11 | **(this)** | Joint-action discharged in general; ...". Commit SHAs, round numbers and "(this)" meaning "the commit you are reading" are pure branch state and name nothing to a reader.
